name: phil/privacy-bundle
description: Privacy law in code for Symfony: personal fields declared by attribute, logs redacted, export and erasure, delayed account deletion, scheduled retention purges with the register of processing, cookie consent refused by default, third-party frames held until consent, requests by verified link, an incident register and anonymized copies of databases

suggest.ext-zlib: To compress the archives of an export, which are stored without it
suggest.doctrine/dbal: For phil:privacy:anonymize, and the tables of the account deletions, the consent proofs, the requests without an account and the incidents
suggest.doctrine/orm: To draw the anonymization plan from #[Anonymize] and #[PersonalData] on Doctrine entities
suggest.doctrine/persistence: To draw the register of processing from every Doctrine entity
suggest.phpunit/phpunit: For AssertsDeclaredCookies, which fails a functional test on a response that sets an undeclared cookie
suggest.symfony/asset-mapper: To serve the Stimulus controllers of the consent and of the frames held until it without a build step
suggest.symfony/console: For phil:privacy:export, phil:privacy:erase, phil:privacy:register, phil:privacy:anonymize, phil:privacy:retention, phil:privacy:deletions, phil:privacy:incident and phil:privacy:incidents
suggest.symfony/mailer: To send the links of the requests made without an account
suggest.symfony/rate-limiter: Required by the requests made without an account, guest_requests.enabled
suggest.symfony/scheduler: For the schedule phil_privacy, which runs the account deletions and the retention schedule
suggest.symfony/stimulus-bundle: To register the Stimulus controllers of the consent and of the frames held until it
